name: Hindelanger Eismanufaktur
kurzbeschreibung:
**Hindelanger Eismanufaktur in Bad Hindelang**

Discover the art of traditional ice cream making at the **Hindelanger Eismanufaktur** in the charming alpine village of **Bad Hindelang**. Nestled in the heart of the **Allgäu** region, this family-run business has been crafting creamy, homemade ice cream since 1985. Indulge in classic flavors like **Vanille**, **Schokolade**, and **Stracciatella**, or try regional specialties such as **Käse** (cheese) or **Apfel-Zimt** (apple-cinnamon). Their famous **Eisbecher**—a warm, fluffy pastry filled with ice cream—is a must-try. Enjoy your treat at their cozy café or take it to-go for a refreshing snack on the **Alpsee** lake or while exploring the stunning **Tiroler** and **Allgäuer** landscapes. A sweet stop for families, couples, and anyone craving a taste of **Allgäu**’s finest!
